verdict.rationale: Wise's docs confirm card issuing capability (debit cards, spend controls, MCC/currency rules) that could support employee cards with defined permissions, but the evidence is drawn mostly from the Wise Platform card-issuing API (aimed at partners building card products) rather than a documented Wise Business dashboard flow for issuing physical cards directly to named employees with roles. Missing for 10: explicit Wise Business UI/feature documentation for inviting employees, assigning roles, and issuing physical cards to them; independent/hands-on confirmation of this employee-card workflow.
